purpose: Reduce repeated RossFast state/table transformation work while preserving the existing 24-candidate-step coarse-plus-two-half temporal-certificate algorithm.

changes: Precompute one table coordinate per node and reuse it across adjacent faces instead of evaluating log10 independently for each face endpoint.
Fuse theta-to-head inversion with next-state inverse-capacity and table-coordinate materialization so the same inversion intermediates provide head and dh/dtheta for the next candidate step.
Keep the initial-state cache derived from the existing head-based inverse_capacity implementation; no external ABI/state field is added.
optimization_design.mathematical_identity_for_fused_inverse_: For s=(theta-theta_r)/(theta_s-theta_r), A=s^(-1/m)-1 and B=A^(1/n), h=-B/alpha and dh/dtheta=(B/A)*(s^(-1/m)/s)/(alpha*n*m*(theta_s-theta_r)).

qualification_domain.same_as: PUB-P2E10 paired-valid E0 domain used by F-ROSS15/F-ROSS16

scientific_gates.candidate_vs_reference: must remain within the existing PUB-P2E10 thresholds for every case

candidate_vs_baseline.head_inf_max: max(1e-8 cm, 0.01 * corresponding PUB-P2E10 head-inf threshold)

performance_screen.baseline_source: extract immutable source_head kernel into a separate build directory
performance_screen.primary_metric: Fortran CPU_TIME around RossFast solve calls only

admission_rule: Do not production-admit from performance alone. Scientific gates must pass first. A resolved hosted-runner improvement is screening evidence; formal performance qualification remains subject to the repository MP host policy.
negative_result_policy: If scientific drift exceeds gates or speed gain is unresolved/small, close without broadening scope. Do not change substeps or certificate topology inside F-ROSS17.
next_permitted_action: Implement only the declared transform-cache optimization in the table kernel, then run paired scientific and performance qualification.
